nodes.name: Schedule 05:05 London
nodes.notes: Five minutes after the cutoff, so the 04:45 sealed collection has already finished writing its file.

nodes.name: Decide with engine v1
nodes.notes: Calls the same engine_v1.decide the backtester calls. The script verifies the seal, prints the decision record and exits non-zero on a refusal, so a blocked morning is never mistaken for a call.

nodes.name: Record shadow call
nodes.notes: Wire to the shadow log. A shadow call is a record of what the frozen book would have said; it places no order and changes no live path.

nodes.name: Alert shadow refusal
nodes.notes: Wire to the existing alert channel. A blocked or abstained morning names the rule that refused it (E1 to E6), so the alert should quote fired_rules rather than only saying no call.

parameters.content: Shadow only. This workflow reads the sealed 05:00 collection, asks engine v1 for the decision and reports it. It writes no warehouse rows, publishes nothing to the dashboard and is not connected to any execution path. A green shadow morning is not evidence of live deployment, causal feature timing or trading edge.
